name: block-invisible-unicode
description: Blocks hidden Unicode in added lines: bidi, tag and plane-14 chars, word joiner, chained invisibles, zero-width/joiners/fillers by ASCII, mid-line BOM, LRM/RLM outside RTL text, selectors after ASCII, private-use runs of 16+. Allows emoji, RTL/Indic/Thai/CJK text, line-start BOM. Not caught: homoglyphs, a joiner between non-ASCII, binary files and text after U+2028 at commit. Runs: commit, agent write, turn's end. Waiver: 'pragma: allowlist invisible-unicode' same line; agent: HEAD only. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo. In Cursor the turn's end is not held: a refusal there is handed back to the agent as a follow-up message, once, and a hook that fails to answer lets the turn end.]
